notes.title: Car Trader Simulator - Update v0.9.8.0a
notes.notes:
Hello Car Traders!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/0583814fc95dc11d3fd57832770862d6d44ca9f5.png

Hello, hello Car Traders, how are your businesses doing these days? They're definitely about to get better pretty soon as we are happy to announce a new update! Check below what has changed - we believe you will quite like what we've prepared for you... 


 A special Christmas user Interface is now available during five weeks of every in-game winter! Will you notice all the visual tweaks and changes that we have prepared for you to feel the Christmas spirit? 
 Mod Tools - you can add your own cars to the game and become even better Car Trader with Santa Claus sledge in your garage! We cannot wait to see your additions and creations
 Added two new songs - variety never hurts, right?
 Over 30 reported minor and major issues fixed!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/39328ac602ebe077518ae2e233c79372a60278b7.png

After updating the game to the newest version you will see a new addition on the main menu of the game - a Mods Icon. Simply by clicking on it you will have a chance to access the menu for mods allowing you to add new cars to the game. Now it's the time to let your imagination go wild because any and all cars will do. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/8665a9c300acd0d8ed4e584dd2ca339c7861919a.png

This is how the mods window looks like. As you can see it has many different options but do not worry - creating a new car is not complicated at all. In order to do so you will have to create a New Package with the "Create Package" option. You can name the package as you prefer. After that is done you will then have an opportunity to create new cars within that particular package. Several options await here allowing you to customize your car as per your wishes and preferences. You can even set whether this particular car will appear damaged or fully repaired in game! 

Last but not least you can choose your own photos for your car. Remember to upload them first to an appropriate folder! In order to see the folder path please put your mouse cursor on the question mark visible in the left top corner of the screen. 

Please remember to start new game when using mods - the older save files might work with the addition of mods but there is a risk of them becoming corrupted and not functioning properly. 

Thank you for sending us your reports and all of the output_logs we received from you! We still await any and all reports you might have - don't be a stranger!

Best regards,
Car Trader Simulator team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/689980/Car_Trader_Simulator/

notes.title: Car Trader Simulator - Update v0.9.7.8a
notes.notes:
Hello Car Traders!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/1604390313e9df5e7cceeefa03b8d2f678d4112f.png

Welcome again! We are happy to let you know that we are introducing another set of changes aimed at enhancing your enjoyment and fixing many of the issues that you have brought to our attention. As we do so we are still encouraging you to post all your feedback and let us know about any possible issues that you are experiencing!  

New fixes:
 (Fixed) Players weren’t able to complete “have one superstar employee” task
 (Fixed) After finishing campaign mode players weren’t able to continue their game because week report wasn’t popping up 
 (Fixed) By bringing the 2nd driver to the mission point players were able to block their campaign 
 (Fixed) The marker of the deceased employee remained on the map
 (Fixed) Loss of employee equipment when he died in an event
 (Fixed) Tutorial - if you left the car you meant to pick up on the map for longer period of time it disappeared
 (Fixed) A phone blocked by a player does not hide after negotiations
 “Scrap Overflow” Achievement is now working properly
 The family loan had a repayment time of less than one minute - now properly reflects the information in-game
 Many other minor bugfixes


Thank you for sending us your reports and all of the output_logs we received from you! 

With this update we are also introducing a small flowchart that will help you gauge where in the story are you currently present. The flowchart will be accessible by selecting Goals and clicking on the Mission X button (yes, it is a button now!). This way you will always have a way of checking your progress! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/4120822af98da6ee63515bcb941f308e2531cd2d.png

Additionally, as an effect of our cooperation with our Community and their brilliant hard work we're introducing changes and new languages to the game campaign. 

 Full Spanish Campaign translation
 Full Italian Campaign translation (Thanks to our community members: Gianluca Nasso, Kodiaq, Lorenzo, Simone)
 Full Russian Campaign Translation ( Thanks to our community members: Daniel Rogovskoy, Freestyler2018, Frenkyns, Leontij, Michalo, Olexsus, Vovkan, Zoqibo)
 Improved French Translation (Thank you for your reports!)

Translation project is still on-going (you can find the project right here) and we are very thankful for your involvement! You rock! 

We have something really amazing coming to our game in the following weeks. It starts with an “M” and ends with an “S”. Can you guess what it is? Let us know in the comments section!

Best regards,
Car Trader Simulator team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/689980/Car_Trader_Simulator/

notes.title: Car Trader Simulator - Update v0.9.7.7a
notes.notes:
Hello Car Traders!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/0e07c23a10eb66b0be31c930bc1e845b6314b500.png

Another day, another set of changes that we are implementing into the game after listening to many of your voices. We are more than thankful for your help and being alert - with every additional feedback we gather the game gets progressively better and that also means that you can have a better experience! 

But without further ado - these are the changes introduced in the new update:


 Minor bug fixes
 Increased money rewards in Campaign Missions
 Improved the balance in “It’s way too quiet” world event
 Added info about how many missions are available when creating a new game in main menu
 Thieves now have “Police Visibility” radius that improves with each Level Up of your employee:

 - Level 1 = 5 range
 - Level 2 = 10 range
 - Level 3 = 15 range
 - Level 4 = 20 range
 - Superstar = 25 range

Remember that you can further improve the radius by giving your thief a police scanner!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/dc6bee27c7e9626ca268ffb540fe177d7b727162.png


Thank you very much for your opinions and feedback and remember that we are constantly fixing any bugs you might find - if it hasn't been fixed yet we will surely do so in next updates!

Don't forget to review the game if you liked it! 

Best regards and Happy Car Trading!
Car Trader Simulator team

 Fixed an issue with displaying the Sandbox Goals - you can start your Car Trading grind right away!

notes.notes:
Hello Car Traders

Have you wondered how Campaign Mode will look like in the full version?

⬇ Today we've got some interesting details for you. 👀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/6c9dae2688d9cce16757c053ca020634ffa5ec0f.png

Firstly, the campaign has 27 missions and 3 paths.

These paths are Mafia, Sleek and Lawful.

Each mission is different related to the path you choose to follow. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/b56d3ec7a5bcfb13b05770c9033a10e7ad6db988.png

The lawfulness and decisions you make will decide which one you will be on. 

The missions in the path are divided as follows:

 0-1
 1-3
 4-6
 7-9

❗ You can switch from Mafia to Sleek after 3 missions, but not from Mafia to Lawful. ❗

notes.title: Car Trader Simulator Devlog #39 - "Employee Update"
notes.notes:
Hello dear Car Trade Simulator fans!

Last time we discussed logos and names for the company. Today we want to change a little topic and talk about employees.

Some of you may remember our devlog long, long time ago about that matter - but we changed some of it - and we think it is a great opportunity to introduce how it is looking now. 

[previewyoutube=h7bkjP4wYOw;full][/previewyoutube]

First change is portrait - now we can see more precisely their role and guess without any mistake if someone is a shady character or on contrary - is a hardworking mechanic that fixes cars. 

Second thing we can see on this picture above is how much salary we will have to pay for that employee, and the “fire” button. We think it is now more clear and readable instead of what we had previously. 

We also added the location of our employee, so we can see clearly if he is waiting inside the building, doing repairs or maybe he is somewhere outside i.e. picking a car we just bought.

Experience is now more clear and visible in our opinion - now we see progress and, what more important, numbers! How much  experience our employees need to level up and how much they already gathered. 

You can compare side by side if you don't remember the old style of our Employee window!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/342b1334c8efa18179efb1280e80b31c9843e1e5.jpg


What do you think about our changes? Are they more visible and more intuitive? Share your thoughts in the comment section! Especially if you are thinking we might add something or something isn’t clear!

Best regards
Car Trader Simulator team

notes.title: Beta Update 27/11/19
- UPDATE FROM DEVS - 17/06 RELEASE DATE -
notes.notes:
- UPDATE FROM DEVS - 17/06 RELEASE DATE -
Hi,

We have some bugs and gameplay balancing issues we still need to fix. We don't want to release the game with these issues unresolved - it would not be fair on you. That means we need a little more time to fix them.

We do not want to release a game with bugs - we would rather face the consequences of delay, than to release a game we feel is not fully ready. It is almost ready, but not 100%. We will release the game only when it is fully ready.

With this said, and with the wider steam game release timeline for this quarter, we have settled on the 17th of June as our final release date. This means the game will be ready but not released for a couple of months, but please understand that we have to take the wider market into consideration when releasing our game.

The final price is $9.99 and the gameplay feedback so far is very positive, the game is not shallow and we have implemented many cool features over the past 6 months. We are happy with the game - except the bugs and some gameplay balancing issues. Which we are working on.

Thanks for your kind understanding and our sincere apologies for the delay.

Regards
The Car Trader Simulator Team
